intro.title: filter and backdrop-filter
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a visually engaging webpage that demonstrates how to apply special visual effects to images and backgrounds. You will learn the core concepts of the CSS `filter` and `backdrop-filter` properties, which allow you to modify elements with effects like blur, brightness, and contrast. The main technologies involved are CSS properties and values, which you will apply directly in a CSS file. By the end, you'll be able to create dynamic, polished visual designs using these powerful styling tools.
intro.usecase: The filter and backdrop-filter properties are essential for creating modern, visually engaging interfaces that users encounter daily. In photo editing applications like Instagram or Photoshop, filters apply effects like blur, brightness, and saturation adjustments to images. Backdrop-filter is commonly used in modal dialogs, notification panels, and iOS-style control centers to create frosted glass effects that blur the background content while keeping foreground elements readable. Developers implement these properties in dashboards, admin panels, and media-rich websites to enhance visual hierarchy, focus user attention, and create immersive experiences without heavy image processing.
